entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Checked 2026-09-09. Original [DAMIT model 6205](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/6205), version 2022-07-13. Prograde radar/optical reconstruction at a radar-calibrated diameter of 1.45 ±0.2 km. Model fields and mesh measurements.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The alternative retrograde pole remains unresolved. - Sampled geometry distance reaches 16.79 m; the 14.5 m transfer cutoff withholds 0.0321% of interior Elevation texels. - No registered reflectance texture is available. Grid marks missing imagery; Elevation is shape-derived radius relative to a sphere, not measured geology.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.
